note: GTA VI income sources — pre-launch stub. Schema v1.1 adds regions[], coordinates, and explicit monetary_dimension fields. Populate from GTA VI wiki and community benchmarks at launch (Nov 19 2026). Schema mirrors data/gta-5/economy/revenue-tiers.json and income-sources.json.

fields_used.net_profit_per_hr_gta$: profit   — GTA$/hr net after costs, solo optimal
fields_used.setup_cost_gta$: price    — full property + upgrade acquisition cost
fields_used.payout_per_run_gta$: revenue  — single run gross payout (before cost)
fields_used.operational_cost_per_run_gta$: cost — ammo, supplies, fees per run
fields_used.passive_yield_per_hr_gta$: yield    — passive income when not actively playing

fields.name: string — display name
fields.category: string — passive | active | heist | contract | enterprise | ambient
fields.play_type: string — passive | semi-passive | active | heist | contract
fields.regions: string[] — region IDs from world/regions.json where activity is available
fields.coordinates: {x: number|null, y: number|null} — primary entrance / trigger location
fields.net_profit_per_hr_gta$: number — GTA$/hr net after costs, solo optimal
fields.setup_cost_gta$: number — full property + upgrade cost (monetary_dimension: price)
fields.payout_per_run_gta$: number — single run gross payout (monetary_dimension: revenue)
fields.operational_cost_per_run_gta$: number — estimated cost per run (monetary_dimension: cost)
fields.passive_yield_per_hr_gta$: number | null — passive income rate (monetary_dimension: yield)
fields.break_even_hrs: number — hours to recoup setup cost
fields.avg_run_time_min: number — average completion time in minutes
fields.prerequisite: string | null — required property or mission
